description: This file defines the ThreadPool class which models the configuration of a thread pool as represented by the <thread-pool> XML element in the OFBiz framework. It includes parsing of XML attributes to configure thread pool parameters such as min/max threads, job queue size, purge settings, polling, and related behavior.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Models the configuration of a thread pool, parsing parameters from an XML <thread-pool> element, and exposing configuration attributes such as thread count limits, job queue size, polling settings, and purge schedule.

methods.name: getFailedRetryMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum retry delay for failed jobs.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Returns the size of the job queue.

methods.name: getMaxThreads
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of threads allowed in the pool.

methods.name: getMinThreads
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of threads in the pool.

methods.name: getPollDbMillis
methods.description: Returns the polling interval in milliseconds for database polls.

methods.name: getPurgeJobDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days to keep purge jobs.

methods.name: getRunFromPools
methods.description: Returns the list of 'run-from-pool' configurations associated with this thread pool.

methods.name: getSendToPool
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the target pool to send jobs to.

methods.name: getTtl
methods.description: Returns the time-to-live (TTL) for idle threads.
